summary: Startup ownership retention is repaired, but two remaining lifecycle blockers deny bounded two-agent readiness: pending-start shutdown still joins without a bound, starving later participant cleanup, and run_host finally replaces the original control exception when its join fails. No further automatic repair was attempted.

scope.kind: Final read-only second-and-last startup-producer ownership re-review; readiness only
scope.environment: Pinned offline Nix/uv; CPython 3.14.7 real threads; synthetic I/O, no inference.

logic_errors.evidence: After interrupted Thread.start launches an actual waiting worker, connect attempts protected join(timeout=0) and retains ownership correctly. Subsequent disconnect instead invokes _join_producer without timeout, taking thread.join(). Both direct disconnect and host.stop remain blocked until the harness releases the worker. host.stop signals all workers but cannot attempt the second connected participant disconnect before the first unbounded join returns. Client/journal stay retained during the wait, so the defect is bounded termination and all-participant cleanup, not premature release.
logic_errors.minimum_contract: Use bounded termination for pending/ambiguous startup ownership while preserving the existing default online join policy; retain thread/client/journal on unconfirmed release and return an explicit error/status so an operator can reap later.

logic_errors.evidence: Actual playing.run_host receives the exact SystemExit raised by interrupted Thread.start. Protected startup cleanup catches an OSError from join and correctly retains the SystemExit and ownership, but the finally host.stop repeats disconnect; its join OSError escapes and becomes the exception returned to the caller instead of the original SystemExit. This is the existing unchanged CLI/lifecycle integration at the repaired startup boundary, not an unrelated API change.
logic_errors.minimum_contract: The actual public run_host cancellation path must preserve the exact original control object and deepest originating start frame when final shutdown also fails; report cleanup failure without replacing that origin or releasing uncertain resources.

confirmed_contracts: Thread object and _producer_start_pending owned before Thread.start; reconnect denied inside start and after interruption.
Control cancellation sets stop_flag and attempts protected zero-timeout join. Direct connect preserves exact control object/deepest frame even for ordinary or control-flow join failures.

ident=None/is_alive=False is not treated as proof of absence. Real unstarted Thread.join raises, retaining thread/client/journal; ordinary unconfirmed startup Exception is raised, not converted to False.
Successful join plus is_alive=False clears thread/pending before client close; subsequent host journal close follows client close. Live or ambiguous startup producers keep journals owned.
Confirmed dead startup worker allows cleanup; default online disconnect still calls join with no arguments, preserving prior fixture contracts and public host API.
Original 25 probes, prior 12 edge probes including both originally failed actual-thread cases, and all 10 new repository cases pass. Existing non-producer startup brain cleanup remains covered.
